残.visual: A few clean white toy bones lie on the left; little leftover puzzle pieces gather on the right as the boy sorts what remains.

念.memory: The now in your heart: wish, thought.
念.visual: A clear present-moment clock or small roof-like NOW symbol sits above one big warm heart; the boy wishes with eyes closed.

労.memory: Fire and strength under a roof: labour.
労.visual: A wide workshop roof shelters small warm sparks at the top; one strong bent arm works below as the boy helps.

例.memory: A person leading the row: example.
例.visual: One person stands at the left edge and points out a neatly ordered row of simple objects on the right as an example.

然.memory: Dog meat over a fire: well then, naturally.
然.visual: A friendly dog rests safely above four separated glowing campfire dots below, while the boy smiles at the natural warmth. No injury or meat.

伝.memory: A person passes the word like a cloud: transmit.
伝.visual: One person stands on the left and sends a small message shaped like a soft cloud to a friend on the right; the boy passes it along.

働.visual: A person stands on the left; a wheel and moving work tool turn on the right while the boy helps operate them.

景.visual: A square golden sun sits high above a compact city with tiered roofs below; the boy admires the scenery.

好.memory: A woman and a child: fond of.
好.visual: A smiling woman stands on the left and a happy child on the right; they hold hands affectionately.

失.memory: Something slips from the hand: lose.
失.visual: A small bright object slips out of one open hand and falls below, while the boy reaches after it in surprise.

差.memory: A hand and a sheep unevenly matched: difference.
差.visual: A fluffy sheep stands above two hands holding unequal piles below; the boy spots the difference.

末.memory: A long line at the tree top: tip, end.
末.visual: One sturdy tree has a noticeably extra-long horizontal top branch; the boy points at its far tip.

種.memory: Grain and its heavy seeds: species, seed.
種.visual: One golden grain stalk fills the left; a heavy stack of different seeds fills the right as the boy sorts their kinds.

望.memory: A king looks at the moon: hope, ambition.
望.visual: A king-like figure with three tiered bands stands below, gazing up at a large moon above; the boy shares the hopeful view.

観.memory: A bird with big eyes sees it all: outlook.
観.visual: A colorful bird stands on the left; one large observing eye with lower legs fills the right as the boy watches carefully.

察.memory: A roof over a festival, eyes alert: guess, inspect.
察.visual: A broad roof covers a tidy festival table of offerings below; the boy closely inspects each small object.

達.memory: A sheep walking to its destination: reach.
達.layout: goal center; road wraps left and bottom
達.visual: A friendly sheep reaches a bright destination marker in the center; a winding road curves from the left beneath it, and the boy celebrates arrival.

良.visual: One tall food sieve or vessel holds clean golden grains; the boy tastes the finished food and gives a happy thumbs-up.

候.memory: A person waits for the weather: climate.
候.visual: One person waits on the left; on the right a tall weather station shows sun, cloud and rain changing over time. No text.

満.visual: Three water drops line the left; a large clear vessel on the right fills right to its rim as the boy watches.

敗.memory: A hand strikes a shell and breaks it: defeat.
敗.visual: A toy shell token stands on the left; a hand taps it from the right and it splits into puzzle pieces after a game defeat. No injury.

積.memory: Grain piled high with debts: pile up.
積.visual: A ripe grain stalk fills the left; a high orderly stack of grain sacks fills the right as the boy piles them up.

飛.visual: One joyful bird spreads two large symmetrical wings from a narrow central body; the boy looks up as it flies.

殺.memory: A hand with a spear: kill.
殺.visual: A soft game target stands on the left; the boy on the right taps it with a padded toy spear and the target falls over. No people or animals harmed.

単.visual: Three small marks sit across the top; below them one simple upright fork-shaped tool stands alone, with the boy showing just one.

完.memory: A roof over the beginning: complete.
完.visual: A broad roof sits atop a complete little house foundation with two legs below; the boy places the final piece.

給.memory: Thread that meets a need: salary.
給.visual: Colored threads hang down the left; on the right a lid fits precisely on a supply box the boy hands to a friend.

辞.memory: A tongue with a sharp needle: word, resign.
辞.visual: One friendly speaking tongue or mouth fills the left; a pointed writing stylus stands on the right as the boy chooses his words. No injury.

愛.memory: A heart held in a hand, walking slowly: love.
愛.visual: A gentle hand cups one warm heart in the middle; two little walking feet step carefully below as the boy follows.

未.memory: A tree still growing: not yet.
未.visual: One young tree has a short upper branch and a visibly longer lower branch; a tiny new bud has not opened yet.

冷.visual: Two crisp blue ice drops line the left; a square hanging order token on the right frosts over as the boy shivers. No letters.

類.memory: Rice, a dog, a head, all sorted: sort, kind.
類.visual: On the left the boy sorts a rice sheaf and a friendly dog into different kinds; one large observing head sits on the right.

熱.memory: Fire under a planted seedling: heat.
熱.visual: A small planted seedling and warm hands occupy the top; exactly four separated glowing fire dots sit below, heating the soil safely.

覚.memory: Light your eyes see: remember, wake.
覚.visual: A bright light glows under a small shelter at the top; one large open eye with little legs below sees and remembers it.

便.memory: A person changes things for the better: convenience.
便.visual: One person stands on the left; a clever improved tool on the right makes their job easier as the boy demonstrates.

努.visual: A determined person works at the top; one large bent muscular arm supports them below as the boy tries hard. No enslavement imagery.

散.memory: Beat the meat and bits scatter.
散.visual: Small colorful paper pieces gather on the left; an open hand sweeps from the right and scatters them safely.

静.memory: Blue, calm and free of conflict: quiet.
静.visual: A blue sky and calm water fill the left; on the right two hands let go of a ribbon and everything becomes still.

喜.memory: A drum and a mouth: rejoice.
喜.visual: One festive drum stands at the top; a huge smiling open mouth below cheers while the boy celebrates.

老.memory: A bent old person with a cane: old.
老.visual: One kindly elderly person bends slightly above a curved walking cane; the boy walks alongside.

徒.memory: Walking along the road: on foot.
徒.visual: A path of short stepping stones runs down the left; the boy walks on foot on the right with two clear legs in motion.

欠.memory: A person with their mouth wide open: yawn, lack.
欠.visual: One big yawning mouth opens above a small person’s two legs; the boy notices the missing breath and yawns too.

願.memory: Head turned to the source: request, vow.
願.visual: A little spring flows from beneath a cliff on the left; a thoughtful head on the right wishes beside it.

笑.memory: Bamboo bending like a laughing person: laugh.
笑.visual: Two bamboo stalks bend across the top; beneath them the boy bends forward laughing with a wide smile.

束.memory: A tree with a band around it: bundle.
束.visual: One upright tree-like bundle of sticks is held tightly by a broad square band across its center; the boy ties it.

折.memory: An axe and a hand: fold, break.
折.visual: A large hand on the left folds a thin branch into two clear angled segments on the right; a safe little craft tool rests nearby.

政.memory: Correct something with a strike: government.
政.visual: One tall straight ruler and foot marker fill the left; a hand on the right adjusts a crooked sign to correct it.

経.memory: Threads run through a loom: pass through.
経.visual: Several bright threads stream down the left and pass through the square frame of a loom on the right as the boy weaves.

現.memory: A jewel you can see: present, real.
現.visual: A shining jewel fills the left; one large seeing eye with small lower legs fills the right as the boy notices it appear.

性.visual: Three heart-like marks stand on the left; a green living sprout grows on the right, showing the nature of life.

制.memory: A knife cuts branches: rule, system.
制.visual: A cluster of growing branches fills the left; upright child-safe shears on the right trim them into an orderly shape.

務.memory: Spear in hand, strength at work: duties.
務.visual: One tall harmless ceremonial spear stands on the left; the boy works diligently with a strong bent arm on the right.

支.memory: A hand holds a branch: support.
支.visual: One branching pole forms a cross at the top; an open hand beneath supports it as the boy steadies the branch.

報.memory: A hand on a kneeling prisoner: report, reward.
報.visual: A tall notice placard stands on the left; the boy on the right hands a rolled report to a friend. No words on the page.

解.memory: A knife cuts the horn off a cow: unravel, solve.
解.visual: A friendly bull’s curved horn sits safely on the left; the boy on the right uses a small tool to untie a knot beside it. No injury.

資.memory: A shell for the next one: assets.
資.visual: A bright next-step marker or small path sits above a shell-shaped resource purse below; the boy gathers supplies for the journey.

際.memory: A gathering at the edge of a hill marks an occasion.
際.visual: The boy stands beside a narrow green hill on the left. On the right he carefully presents a layered festival offering with a little star above it; the pieces follow 祭.

判.memory: A blade divides the half mark to decide.
判.visual: A broad half-shaped divider stands on the left, its horizontal bars clear. The boy uses a safe, rounded craft blade at the far right to divide two colored cards equally.

在.memory: A sprout planted firmly in earth is here.
在.layout: stem above and left; earth below
在.visual: A sprout’s long slant and upright stem rise from a simple layered mound of earth. The boy points to it: it is here. Keep the 土 cross and base visible below.

件.memory: A person and a cow have a matter to discuss.
件.visual: The boy stands as a slim upright figure on the left, speaking gently with a friendly cow on the right; its upright horns and crossbar echo 牛.

任.memory: A person takes charge of a tall task.
任.visual: The boy stands at the left and steadies a tall upright post on the right with two clear horizontal rails. A small duty ribbon sits on the post.

増.memory: Soil adds one more layer to the stack.
増.visual: A little soil mound with a crisp cross shape sits on the left. The boy adds another level to a right-hand stack with paired marks above, a square middle and a sunlike bottom.

情.memory: A heart fills with clear blue feeling.
情.layout: heart drops left; blue tower right
情.visual: Three heart-shaped droplets form the slim left side. A tall blue sprout and glowing moonlike base fill the right as the boy shows a warm, expressive face.

示.memory: A small altar displays its shining gift.
示.layout: shelf above; stem and legs below
示.visual: The boy proudly shows a tiny star on a flat two-tier display shelf. One central stem and two short outward legs beneath the shelf preserve the 示 silhouette.

確.memory: A stone and a sheltered bird make the answer firm.
確.visual: A sturdy stone with an open mouthlike face sits on the left. On the right, a small bird stands under a narrow roof, with its upright body and three wing bars visible; the boy gives a confident nod.

容.memory: A roof contains the whole valley.
容.visual: A broad rounded roof arches over a narrow V-shaped valley with a small square opening at its bottom. The boy tucks supplies inside the sheltered valley.

演.memory: Water joins a play beneath the stage roof.
演.layout: water left; roof and stage right
演.visual: Three blue drops run down the left. On the right a roof covers a square stage with a central upright panel and two little feet; the boy performs with a bright ribbon.

能.memory: The little creature shows what it can do.
能.visual: A cheerful creature has a small head over a tall crescent belly at the left and two clear hooked feet stacked at the right. It balances a star to show its skill.

格.memory: Each visitor finds a place by the tree.
格.visual: A clean branch-and-trunk tree rises on the left. On the right a tiny walking visitor descends from above to call from a square mouth at the bottom; the boy gives each a place.

過.memory: The winding road goes beyond the stacked doorway.
過.layout: chamber center right; road wraps left and bottom
過.visual: A tall lopsided chamber with a small square opening stands at the right. A curving path sweeps from the left beneath it, and the boy walks past its far edge.

常.memory: The familiar lamp shines above the everyday cloth.
常.visual: A tiny lit room with three rays sits at the top. Under it hangs a simple broad cloth on a central peg, its two sides straight; the boy reaches for his usual scarf.

状.memory: The dog’s condition is marked beside him.
状.visual: Two slim upright marker boards stand on the left. A friendly dog on the right stretches its four limbs around a central body; the boy checks how it feels.

職.memory: A listening ear and work bell announce the job.
職.layout: ear left; bell and tool right
職.visual: A tall ear with three inner bars fills the left. On the right a stacked music bell and a safe crossed work tool make a job signal; the boy listens for it.

構.memory: Timber beams lock into a growing frame.
構.visual: A simple tree trunk with horizontal boughs stands at the left. The boy assembles interlocking horizontal beams into a tall open frame on the right.

断.visual: A bundle of short yarn strands is held in a slim open frame at the left. At the right the boy uses a blunt craft axe to split the loose strands, making a clear break.

規.memory: A person looks closely at the measuring rule.
規.layout: person left; eye and legs right
規.visual: A standing person with extended arms fills the left. On the right a large square eye above little legs studies a straight measuring rule between them.

術.memory: A careful path surrounds the little craft.
術.layout: road columns flank center; sprout in middle
術.visual: Two narrow parallel walking lanes frame the image at left and right. In the center the boy carefully ties one dot or bead to a small upright sprout, showing a practiced technique.

備.memory: A person stocks a ready quiver.
備.layout: person left; rack and quiver right
備.visual: The boy stands as a slim figure at the left. On the right a little rack above a long vertical quiver holds neatly arranged arrows, ready for the trip.

限.memory: A hill sets the boundary for a watchful traveler.
限.layout: hill left; eye and foot right
限.visual: A narrow cliff rises on the left. On the right a large watchful eye sits above a planted foot at a bright boundary line; the boy stops there.

退.memory: A foot turns back along the road.
退.layout: eye and foot center right; road wraps left and bottom
退.visual: A wide eye over a foot faces back toward the boy at the right. A curved road sweeps from left to bottom as he steps safely away.

非.memory: Two feathered sides point away from one another.
非.layout: parallel rails left and right, strokes point outward
非.visual: Two upright rails stand side by side, each with three short feather bars pointing away from the middle. The boy shakes his head between them: no.

財.memory: A shell purse holds a talented gift.
財.visual: A tall shell-shaped purse with two inner eye marks and little feet sits at the left. The boy ties a ribbon around a slim cross-shaped talent marker on the right.

識.memory: Words and a sound mark help the boy recognize it.
識.visual: A tall stack of speech lines and a square mouth runs down the left. On the right a little bell sits above a distinctive crossed mark; the boy recognizes its sound.

程.memory: Grain rises to the marked measuring height.
程.visual: A grain stalk with a top tuft and side leaves grows at the left. On the right a small square label stands above a three-bar measuring pole, showing how far the grain reaches.

師.memory: The guide leads beside a tall banner.
師.visual: A friendly guide with a stacked cap-like crest stands on the left. A straight pole with a wide hanging banner fills the right as the boy follows the lesson.

易.memory: The sun lifts a few light sweeping ribbons.
易.visual: A simple square sun glows at the top. Below it three curved rays or light ribbons sweep down to the right; the boy lifts one with ease.

破.memory: A stone tears a strip of leather.
破.visual: A firm stone with a little square opening sits at the left. The boy pulls apart a soft leather strip on the right, its forked hanging shape still visible.

責.memory: A thorny request sits above the shell purse.
責.layout: thorny growth above; shell purse below
責.visual: A short upright sprout crossed by three bars stands above a shell-shaped purse with inner marks and tiny feet. The boy carefully accepts the duty of caring for it.

因.memory: The big figure inside the frame starts the story.
因.visual: A bold square picture frame encloses the boy with arms and legs spread in a large 大 shape. A small glowing cause-and-effect spark starts at his hand inside the frame.

富.memory: A full jar beneath a roof holds the treasure.
富.visual: A broad roof shelters a tall jar below, with a narrow neck, square middle opening and divided lower compartment. The boy finds plenty of rice inside.

適.memory: The road leads to the fitting little house.
適.layout: house center right; road wraps left and bottom
適.visual: A small house with pointed roof, wide middle frame and square door stands on the right. A winding road wraps from the left beneath it; the boy arrives at a perfect fit.

婦.memory: The woman stands beside a broom.
婦.visual: A capable woman with the crossing 女 silhouette stands at the left. A tall broom with a wrapped head and hanging bristles stands at the right; she and the boy tidy together.

寄.memory: Under the roof, a curious visitor draws near.
寄.layout: roof above; figure over square stand below
寄.visual: A broad roof tops the scene. Below it a large-armed visitor balances over a small square stand and the boy approaches to say hello.

余.memory: A person has extra stores below the roofline.
余.layout: person roof above; shelf and spare strokes below
余.visual: A person’s broad triangular arms make a roof at the top. Under them a vertical shelf crosses two bars, with two little spare supplies falling to either side; plenty is left over.

妻.memory: A woman tidies her hair with a hand above.
妻.layout: hand and comb above; woman below
妻.visual: An adult woman forms the crossed 女 shape at the bottom. Above her, one hand holds a straight comb through her hair, with the horizontal upper strokes clear.

険.memory: A steep hill and a crowded ledge call for care.
険.layout: cliff left; ledges and people right
険.visual: A narrow steep cliff stands at the left. On the right a small roof covers stacked ledges and two people below; the boy steps carefully along the safe path.

許.memory: Spoken words give the go-ahead at noon.
許.visual: The boy speaks beside a tall stack of speech lines on the left. On the right a sunlit vertical post with a short top slash and horizontal crossbar stands for 午; a green go-ahead ribbon connects them.

留.memory: A field keeps the little visitor for a while.
留.visual: Two curved hooklike ribbons hang at the top. Below them is a crisp four-part rice field; the boy waits cheerfully beside it.

罪.memory: A net catches the crossed-out mistake.
罪.visual: A broad four-pane net stretches above. Beneath it two parallel rails with short bars pointing outward form 非; the boy spots a harmless crossed-out mistake.

精.memory: Rice becomes a bright blue gem.
精.visual: A plump rice grain star with eight rays fills the left. On the right a bright blue upright sprout stands over a moonlike base; the boy polishes one grain until it gleams.

絶.memory: A thread ends at a vivid color ribbon.
絶.visual: A tall loose spool and three thread dots fill the left. The thread stops at a large folded color ribbon on the right, whose top hook and lower curled tail echo 色.

居.memory: An old story rests under a shelter.
居.layout: shelter around top and left; old sign below
居.visual: A curved shelter roofs the scene and drops down the left. Under it an upright old sign has a cross above a square opening; the boy settles in with a cushion.

雑.memory: Nine different things gather by a bird.
雑.layout: nine and tree left; bird right
雑.visual: At the left nine colorful trinkets cluster around a small tree. At the right a tidy bird stands tall with visible wing bars; the boy sorts the mixed collection.

招.memory: A waving hand calls a visitor over.
招.layout: hand left; call above mouth right
招.visual: A tall waving hand rises at the left. A curved inviting ribbon at upper right bends toward a square speaking mouth below; the boy welcomes a friend.

賛.memory: Two friends offer a shell purse in approval.
賛.layout: two figures above; shell purse below
賛.visual: Two little standing friends with outstretched arms sit side by side at the top. They lift a large shell purse with inner eye marks below; the boy applauds.

犯.memory: A curious animal crosses a marked boundary.
犯.visual: A harmless curious doglike animal stands tall on the left. A bold bent boundary marker curls down on the right; the boy gently guides it back after it crosses the line.

似.memory: A person copies a simple pose.
似.visual: The boy forms a slim upright figure at the left. On the right a second tiny figure repeats his bent pose across a little center dot, showing resemblance.

迷.memory: Rice grains wander off the winding road.
迷.layout: rice center right; road wraps left and bottom
迷.visual: A single rice-shaped star sits at upper right, with six clear rays. A curved path sweeps around from the left beneath it as the boy searches for his way.

夢.memory: At dusk a covered scene becomes a dream.
夢.layout: grass and wide cover above; moon below
夢.visual: A little grassy crest and horizontal eye sit beneath a broad top cover. Underneath, a crescent evening moon curls down; the boy sleeps and dreams of stars.

慣.memory: A heart repeats the same threaded path.
慣.visual: Three heart drops form the left side. On the right a straight cord passes through a tall stack of shelllike tokens; the boy repeats the familiar routine.

貧.memory: The divided shell purse has little left.
貧.visual: Two downward slanted arms at top split a small token. Beneath sits a shell purse with its inner marks visible and only one coin; the boy shares kindly.

祖.memory: A family offering stands beside stacked generations.
祖.visual: A slim offering altar with one top dot and two side marks rises on the left. On the right three horizontal family tablets stack inside a tall frame; the boy remembers his family.

権.memory: A tree stands beside a bird under a crown of grass.
権.visual: A simple tree with strong trunk fills the left. On the right a tall bird with layered wings stands under a small grassy crown; the boy receives a symbolic key to care for the garden.

済.memory: Water brings every line into balance.
済.visual: Three blue water drops run down the left. On the right a broad top line, crossing pair and two aligned lower marks form a tidy finish line; the boy completes the task.

認.layout: speech left; blade and heart right
認.visual: Tall speech lines end in a square mouth at the left. At the right a safe paper-cutting blade shape rests above a soft heart; the boy calmly says what happened.

論.memory: Spoken words are placed in order.
論.layout: speech left; person roof and shelves right
論.visual: A tall stack of speech lines fills the left. On the right a triangular person-roof covers several neatly ordered shelves; two friends discuss the ideas.

疑.memory: Two paths make the traveler hesitate.
疑.layout: questioning figure left; forked path right
疑.visual: A curious figure with a hooked question mark shape stands at the left. Two branching steps and an upright path sit at the right; the boy pauses between them.

供.memory: A person offers a shared tray.
供.visual: The boy stands as a tall slim figure at the left. On the right two upright hands support a broad horizontal tray with two little feet; he offers food to friends.

割.memory: A safe cutter separates two matching shares.
割.visual: A roof covers a stack of horizontal layers above a small square opening at the left. A rounded upright craft blade at the right parts the stack into fair shares.

難.memory: A tangled task stands beside a determined bird.
難.visual: A dense crisscrossing bundle of colored ribbons fills the left. A small upright bird with clear wing stripes stands at the right; the boy carefully untangles the hard task.

優.memory: A person gently supports a worried heart.
優.layout: person left; layered heart and feet right
優.visual: The boy forms a slim figure at the left. On the right a broad cover tops a watchful eye, a warm heart and little walking feet; he offers gentle help.

収.memory: A hand gathers a harvest into a narrow basket.
収.visual: A tall narrow hooked basket rail stands at the left. At the right a clear two-stroke hand lifts a few grain heads into it; the boy receives the harvest.

宅.memory: A small plant settles under a roof.
宅.visual: A broad roof arches across the top. A short slanted shoot, long vertical stem and bent root grow below it; the boy welcomes it home.

警.memory: Careful action and words sound an alert.
警.visual: At the top a small grassy sign, square call and careful hand make an alert gesture. Below, stacked speech lines end in a square mouth as the boy warns friends of a puddle.

訪.memory: Words travel toward a chosen direction.
訪.visual: Tall speech lines and a square mouth fill the left. On the right a broad top flag narrows into a slanting path; the boy follows it to visit a friend.

若.memory: Tender grass grows above a helping hand.
若.visual: Two fresh grass shoots sit across the top. Beneath, a large right-hand arm reaches around a small square opening; the boy admires the young plant.

段.memory: Each step needs one careful tap.
段.visual: Three short ledges stack like a stair at the left. At the right a safe little tapping hand with bent wrist marks each level as the boy climbs.

呼.memory: A mouth sends a breath across the air.
呼.visual: A big square calling mouth sits at the left. On the right a small top puff crosses a long horizontal breath line and vertical stem; the boy calls a friend.

値.memory: A person looks straight at the price.
値.visual: The boy forms a slim upright figure at the left. On the right a straight top cross stands above a tall framed eye with horizontal bars; a small price tag hangs below.

処.memory: Walking feet arrive at the little desk.
処.layout: feet above left; desk below right
処.visual: Two curved walking steps enter from upper left. A small two-legged desk stands at lower right; the boy reaches it to deal with a task.

否.memory: The mouth says no beneath the crossed sign.
否.visual: A broad horizontal no-sign with slanting arms fills the top. Beneath it a square mouth says no, while the boy shakes his head politely.

存.memory: A child lives beneath a sheltering sprout.
存.visual: A long slanted shelter and short upright stem form the upper shape. A small child with a round head and crossing arms stands safely below; the boy points to the child who is here.

座.memory: Two people sit on earth under a roof.
座.layout: roof around top and left; people and earth below
座.visual: A broad awning bends over from the top and down the left. Beneath it two friends sit symmetrically on a clear earth platform; the boy offers a seat.

除.memory: A hill is cleared of extra stones.
除.layout: hill left; person-roof and shelf right
除.visual: A narrow hill rises on the left. At the right a person-shaped roof covers a crossed shelf with two loose pebbles; the boy removes the extras.

降.memory: Two feet come down the hill.
降.visual: A steep but friendly hill stands at the left. On the right two successive foot shapes step down over a short horizontal landing; the boy descends carefully.

危.memory: A figure near the cliff pauses at the edge.
危.layout: bent figure above; cliff and foot below
危.visual: At the top a small bent figure leans toward a cliff. Below, a curved foot stops just before the edge; the boy notices the danger and steps back.

亡.memory: An empty corner shows someone has gone.
亡.layout: top line above; open corner below
亡.visual: A little top line and dot form a rooflike marker above an empty open corner. The boy gently notices an empty place where a friend was.

背.memory: Two figures stand back to back above the body.
背.visual: Two tiny figures face away from one another across a center gap at the top. Below, a rounded upright body with two inner bands supports them; the boy points to his back.

勤.memory: Strong arms work through a tall garden task.
勤.layout: stacked garden left; strong arm right
勤.visual: On the left a grassy crest sits above a tall stack of soil layers. On the right one big bent arm works steadily as the boy cares for the garden.

困.memory: A tree is crowded inside a square fence.
困.visual: A simple tree with clear branches and trunk fills a square fence so tightly its leaves touch the sides; the boy helps make room.

刻.memory: A craft blade engraves a patterned block.
刻.visual: A layered block with top cap, crossed middle and two lower legs fills the left. A rounded upright craft blade at the right makes a small decorative engraving.

欲.memory: A valley opens beside a reaching breath.
欲.visual: A V-shaped valley with a small square opening sits at the left. On the right a bent figure reaches toward a wished-for star; the boy’s hopeful face shows wanting.

痛.memory: A sore place sits under the sickness shelter.
痛.layout: shelter around top and left; tunnel inside
痛.visual: A sloping roof with two small side dots shelters the scene from top and left. Inside, a narrow path passes through a square tunnel; the boy holds a small bandage.

探.memory: A hand reaches into a covered nook.
探.layout: hand left; nook above tree right
探.visual: The boy’s long reaching hand fills the left. On the right a little cover with two hanging dots sits above a small tree; he searches beneath it for a hidden star.

閉.memory: A crossbar locks the tall gate.
閉.visual: Two tall gate leaves with square inner panels frame a central crossing bar. The boy gently slides the bar across to close the gate.

暮.memory: The sun settles beneath grass and a wide horizon.
暮.layout: grass top; horizon middle; sun bottom
暮.visual: A grassy crest forms the top. A broad spreading horizon sits in the middle and a square sun drops below it; the boy watches dusk arrive.

吸.memory: The mouth draws a ribbon inward.
吸.visual: A square open mouth sits at the left. A curled ribbon with a top hook and long lower sweep bends toward it from the right as the boy takes a breath.

忘.memory: What is gone leaves a little gap in the heart.
忘.visual: An open corner beneath a top dot forms the upper gone sign. A plump heart with three small pulses sits below; the boy searches kindly for a forgotten thought.

誤.memory: Words turn toward the wrong answer.
誤.layout: speech left; mouth and legs right
誤.visual: Stacked speech lines and a square mouth fill the left. On the right a second square mouth sits over two stepping legs pointing the wrong way; the boy corrects a harmless mistake.

洗.memory: Water pours over the first step.
洗.layout: water left; top mark and legs right
洗.visual: Three blue water drops descend at the left. On the right a short slant and crossbar stand over a pair of walking legs; the boy washes his hands before setting off.

窓.memory: A heart looks out through the roof opening.
窓.layout: roof and small opening above; heart below
窓.visual: A broad roof with two little hanging light marks frames a window at the top. Under it a small view and warm heart form the lower shape; the boy looks outside.

腹.memory: The body rests beside a returning foot.
腹.layout: body left; sun and steps right
腹.visual: A rounded upright body with two inner bands fills the left. On the right a tiny capped square sun stands above walking feet; the boy pats a full belly after lunch.

頂.memory: A tall post reaches the very top of a head.
頂.visual: A clean upright post with a top bar stands at the left. On the right a friendly head shape with wide hair cap, tall face and little legs rises to its highest point; a star marks the top.

晩.memory: The sun slips behind a turning figure.
晩.visual: A square sun glows at the left. On the right a capped figure with square middle and curled lower legs turns away as evening begins; the boy lights a lantern.

歳.memory: A little step marks another year.
歳.layout: step above; crossed tally center; small strokes below
歳.visual: A clear stopping foot stands at the top. Below it a safe crossed tally line and three tiny marks count another passing year while the boy adds a calendar star.

与.memory: One little gift passes from hand to hand.
与.layout: bent hand above; gift line below
与.visual: A simple bent hand reaches from above and presents a single horizontal ribbon or gift below. The boy passes it to a friend.

違.memory: One foot turns a different way on the road.
違.layout: opposed feet center right; road wraps left and bottom
違.visual: A vertical sign with two little feet facing opposite directions stands at the right. A curved road wraps from left beneath it as the boy chooses a different path.

渡.memory: Water lies beside the measured crossing.
渡.layout: water left; shelter and path right
渡.visual: Three blue water drops run down the left. A broad shelter at the right covers a horizontal bridge and a stepping hand; the boy crosses the water.

突.memory: A playful dog pops through an opening.
突.visual: A broad roof with two tiny hanging marks frames a round opening above. A friendly dog springs up from below with spread limbs and one little dot.

捕.memory: A hand catches the marked bundle.
捕.visual: A long reaching hand fills the left. At the right a tall bundle with top dot, square middle and central vertical tie is caught gently by the boy.

迎.memory: A greeting figure waits beside the winding road.
迎.layout: greeter center right; road wraps left and bottom
迎.visual: A friendly greeter bends forward at the right with one raised hand. A curved road wraps from left beneath them as the boy welcomes a visitor.

彼.memory: That traveler walks beside a leather cloak.
彼.visual: Two small stepping marks lead down the left. On the right a traveler wears a leather cloak with a top crest and forked lower fold; the boy points to him.

舞.memory: Flowing sleeves rise above crossing dance feet.
舞.layout: flowing sleeves above; opposed feet below
舞.visual: A row of flowing sleeves and tiny hanging tassels fills the top. Beneath, two feet turn in opposite directions with a clear center crossing as the boy dances.

込.memory: Many friends enter along one curved road.
込.layout: entering pair center right; road wraps left and bottom
込.visual: A simple V-shaped pair of footsteps enters at the upper right. A winding road curves from left beneath them while several tiny friends queue along it.

頼.memory: A tied bundle rests beside a trusted head.
頼.visual: A neat vertical bundle crossed by two straps fills the left. On the right a friendly head with cap, face and lower feet looks over it; the boy asks for help.

途.memory: A spare shelf stands along the winding road.
途.layout: shelf center right; road wraps left and bottom
途.visual: A person-shaped top shelters a crossed shelf with two little supplies at the right. A curved path wraps from left beneath it, giving the boy a clear route.

抜.memory: A hand pulls a friend from a snug spot.
抜.visual: A tall pulling hand fills the left. On the right two friendly hands cross under a short overhang as the boy helps a friend out of a soft pile of leaves.

婚.memory: Two partners meet under the evening sun.
婚.visual: An adult woman with the crossed 女 silhouette stands at the left. On the right a slanting horizon sits over a square setting sun; two partners celebrate together at dusk.

浮.layout: water left; hands above child right
浮.visual: Three blue water drops run down the left. On the right two cupped hands hover above a small child-shaped float; the boy watches it bob safely on water.

押.memory: A hand pushes the square shield.
押.visual: A tall open hand presses from the left against a square shield on the right, with its central vertical and crossbar plainly visible.

倒.memory: A person tips beside the arrival marker.
倒.layout: person left; marker and blade right
倒.visual: A slim figure at the left tips gently onto a cushion. On the right an upright arrival marker with base and a safe straight craft blade marks the place.

払.memory: A hand passes a small private token.
払.visual: The boy’s upright hand reaches from the left. A small curled triangular token at the right passes to a shopkeeper as payment.

遅.memory: A sheep moves slowly from a shelter onto the road.
遅.layout: shelter and sheep center right; road wraps left and bottom
遅.visual: A friendly sheep with clear horns and horizontal wool bands stands under a curved shelter at right. A winding road wraps from left beneath it; the boy waits as it arrives late.

更.memory: The sun gains one more crossing mark.
更.layout: top line above; sun middle; crossing stroke below
更.visual: A horizontal horizon runs above a square sun. Two diagonal sweeping lines cross below it like another tally as the boy watches the day grow later.

抱.memory: A hand wraps gently around a friend.
抱.visual: A tall open hand fills the left. On the right a broad curled ribbon encloses a tiny smiling friend, with a lower bent tail; the boy gives a warm hug.

恐.memory: A heart trembles beneath a crossed tool.
恐.visual: At the top a safe crossed craft tool and small mark form a compact shape. A soft heart with three pulse drops sits beneath; the boy feels afraid and reaches for a friend.

戻.memory: A big figure comes back through the door.
戻.layout: door above and left; big figure below
戻.visual: A broad door frame curves over from top and down the left. Beneath it the boy spreads his arms and legs in a big 大 pose as he returns home.

越.memory: A runner crosses over a high mark.
越.visual: A running figure with a top earth marker and long lower step fills the left. On the right a safe slanted pole crosses a tall mark; the boy runs beyond it.

互.memory: Two hooks fit together in the middle.
互.layout: top line above; two hooks middle; base line below
互.visual: Two colorful hook shapes turn toward one another and connect between a top and bottom horizontal rail. Two friends share a gift back and forth.

逃.memory: A traveler takes the road away from a split sign.
逃.layout: split sign center right; road wraps left and bottom
逃.visual: A central upright sign splits into two curling marks at right. A curved path sweeps from left beneath it as the boy hurries away from a harmless rain cloud.

緒.memory: The first thread starts with a person’s mark.
緒.layout: thread left; person and sun right
緒.visual: A tall thread spool with three loose dots stands at the left. On the right a small personlike cross stands above a square sun; the boy ties the first knot of a new project.

掛.memory: A hand hangs two square signs on a peg.
掛.layout: hand left; paired signs center; peg right
掛.visual: A tall reaching hand fills the left. Two small stacked cross-shaped signs hang at center from an upright peg on the far right; the boy adjusts them.

到.memory: A traveler reaches a marker beside the upright blade.
到.visual: A small traveler lands on a horizontal base beneath a top arrow at left. A safe upright craft blade shape marks the far right edge; a bright star celebrates arrival.

寝.memory: A resting figure lies beneath the roof.
parts: bed and resting hand (寢 lower shape)
寝.layout: roof above; bed and hand below
寝.visual: A broad roof spans the top. Beneath it a long bed with layered blanket fills the left and a curled resting hand lies at the right; the boy sleeps peacefully.

盗.memory: A missing dish leaves a gap beneath the next step.
盗.visual: At the top a person shaped like an open reaching breath looks beside two small marks. Below is a wide empty dish on short legs; the boy notices a missing cookie.

御.memory: Careful steps lead to a respectful gate.
御.layout: steps left; stacked sign and kneeling mark right
御.visual: Two small walking steps descend the left. On the right a tall marked sign stands beside a small bent greeting figure; the boy offers a respectful bow.

吹.memory: A mouth sends a gust toward a reaching figure.
吹.visual: A square mouth at the left puffs a soft gust. On the right a bent figure with open arms and little legs leans into the breeze; the boy blows a paper pinwheel.

娘.memory: A young woman stands beside a bright good-luck sign.
娘.visual: A cheerful daughter forms the crossed 女 silhouette at the left. On the right a tall good-luck sign has a top dot, square middle and sweeping lower foot; she smiles with her family.

怒.memory: An upset heart needs a calm hand.
怒.layout: figure and hand above; heart below
怒.visual: At the top a figure and bent hand show a small disagreement. A soft heart with three pulse marks below turns red as the boy feels angry, then takes a breath.

杯.memory: A wooden cup holds a simple drink.
杯.visual: A small tree trunk with branch arms stands at the left. On the right a flat top and forked lower stand hold a wooden cup; the boy lifts it.

疲.memory: A worn cloak rests beneath the sickness shelter.
疲.layout: shelter top and left; cloak inside
疲.visual: A sloping shelter with two side dots frames the scene. Inside a soft leather cloak with top crest and forked lower fold droops as the boy takes a rest.

皆.memory: Two figures gather above a bright shared square.
皆.layout: paired figures above; white square below
皆.visual: Two small matching figures stand side by side at the top. Below them a bright square white gathering mat with top dot brings everyone together.

煙.memory: Fire sends curls above a tall clay chimney.
煙.visual: Warm orange flames make four clear rays at the left. On the right a tall capped chimney stands over a small earth base; gentle smoke curls upward while the boy watches safely.

眠.memory: The eye closes beside a quiet person.
眠.visual: A tall framed eye with inner bars stands at the left and slowly closes. At the right a bent person shape with a top frame and lower curled foot rests; the boy sleeps.

怖.memory: A trembling heart hides behind a cloth.
怖.visual: Three heart drops form the left. On the right a short overhang supports a wide hanging cloth with a central vertical fold; the boy peeks from behind it.

髪.memory: Long strands sweep above a friendly hand.
髪.layout: hair fringe above; crossed hands below
髪.visual: A broad top comb and several long curling hair strands flow down from above. Two crossed friendly hands below help the boy tie the hair.

忙.memory: The heart races as the last moment slips away.
忙.visual: Three energetic heart drops stand at the left. On the right a top dot and line hover over an open corner sign; the boy hurries between two small tasks.

靴.memory: Leather changes shape into a pair of shoes.
靴.visual: A tall leather frame with grassy top, square middle and central cross fills the left. On the right two changing figure poses turn into a pair of comfy shoes for the boy.

恥.memory: An ear hears the heart’s blush.
恥.visual: A tall ear with three inner bars fills the left. A soft pink heart with three pulse marks sits on the right as the boy blushes after a small mistake.

偶.memory: A person unexpectedly meets a patterned creature.
偶.visual: A slim walking person stands at the left. At the right a friendly creature with square top, framed body and curled tail appears by chance; both look surprised.

偉.memory: A person guides two feet through a difficult route.
偉.visual: The boy stands tall as a slim figure on the left. On the right a vertical guide sign is flanked by two little feet facing opposite ways; he helps them find the route.

猫.memory: A cat explores the seedlings by the field.
猫.layout: cat left; seedlings and field right
猫.visual: A friendly cat with an upright curving tail fills the left. On the right two tiny grass shoots grow above a crisp four-pane field; the cat pads among them.

幾.memory: Tiny paired threads invite a count.
幾.layout: paired threads above; crossed tally and feet below
幾.visual: Two small matching loops of thread sit side by side at the top. Below, a safe crossed tally line and two little feet mark the count as the boy asks how many.
